description.zh: 1937 年 10 月新四军在汉口成立，军部后经南昌、岩寺移驻安徽泾县云岭。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: The New Fourth Army was formed at Hankou in October 1937; its headquarters later moved via Nanchang and Yansi to Yunling in Jingxian, Anhui. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 新四军：黄桥—盐城（重建军部）

description.zh: 1940 年 11 月华中新四军八路军总指挥部北移，1941 年 1 月 25 日在盐城重建新四军军部。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In November 1940 the Central China N4A–Eighth Route Army command moved north; on 25 January 1941 the N4A headquarters was re-established at Yancheng. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

description.zh: 1941 年 1 月，新四军军部及所属部队 9000 余人由云岭出发北移，在泾县茂林地区遭国民党军围攻（皖南事变）。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In January 1941 the N4A headquarters and over 9,000 troops moved north from Yunling and were encircled by KMT forces at Maolin in Jingxian (Wannan Incident). Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.
